本页面使用 {framework} 构建。在下方切换语言，所有文案会立即更新，无: This page is built with {framework}. Switch the language below and every label updates instantly — no page reload required.
翻译存放在 src/locales/*.json 中，键名就是中文原文。: Translations live in src/locales/*.json and the keys are the Chinese source text.
首次访问时跟随浏览器语言，无法识别时使用中文源文案。: The first visit follows your browser language and falls back to the Chinese source text.
切换语言会同时更新界面、<html lang> 属性和页面标题。: The switcher updates the UI, the <html lang> attribute and the document title.
你的选择会写入 localStorage，下次访问时自动恢复。: Your selection is stored in localStorage and restored on the next visit.
同一个中文词在不同场景下可以对应不同的英文，通过 __TRANS_ID 区分。: The same Chinese word can map to different English strings via __TRANS_ID.
永久销毁且不可恢复：删除用户、数据库记录或备份。: Permanent and irreversible: deleting a user, a database record or a backup.
仅解除关联，对象仍然存在：把用户移出角色组、从仪表盘移除卡片。: Only the association is removed while the object remains: removing a user from a role group or a card from a dashboard.
